title: 3.11 Our and Their
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Include the speaker with our and refer to another owning group with their.
grammar_function: Our/their + familiar singular or plural noun; the speaker is included only in our.
prerequisite: 3.10 my/your/his/her; Unit 2 familiar objects, plurals and this/that/these/those.
speaking_outcome: Describe our and their car, house, books and phones from a clear speaker perspective.
